title: Files to touch when adding a new resource type to unified storage
answers: What do I need to change to register a new resource kind in unified storage?
Adding a new k8s resource type to Grafana storage: what is the checklist?
body: Adding a new resource type touches: resource/app_manifests.go:AppManifests() (CI-checked via make gen-app-manifests-unistore); a SearchFieldsProvider (resource/search_field.go around line 196) which feeds search/bleve_mappings.go, an on-disk index format contract; optionally migrations/registry.go and legacysql/dualwrite for legacy interop; and RBAC checks in resource/access.go plus search/bleve_postrank_authz.go.
applies: Applies when registering an entirely new resource kind in unified storage; not needed for changes to an existing resource's fields only.
